featured_reviews.review_text:
S. L. Raheja Hospital, Mahim — Truly Caring Hands

S. L. Raheja Hospital in Mahim is one of the few hospitals in Mumbai that genuinely combines medical excellence with compassion. The doctors here are experienced and attentive, explaining every detail clearly and making sure patients feel comfortable throughout their treatment.

The nursing staff is polite, patient, and always ready to help, while the hospital maintains high hygiene standards and well-managed facilities. From admission to discharge, the process was smooth and well-coordinated.

A special mention to the overall atmosphere — calm, organized, and reassuring even during stressful times. Truly a hospital where care meets trust.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Aparaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
My father was admitted this month under CGHS benefits for diabetic foot surgery. As very few hospitals in Mumbai are empanelled under Central Government Health Schemes, we were relieved to get admission here.

The OPD procedures went smoothly. We were later informed that the patient would need to be admitted for a short duration (around two days) for surgical treatment. Since a private room was unavailable at the time, we opted for a multi-sharing ward.

Overall, the surgical treatment and interactions with the doctors and specialists were excellent. Dr. Rajeev Singh and his team took great care of the patient and kept us informed about the surgery schedule in advance, ensuring the admission was not done unnecessarily early.

However, the experience with the nursing staff was disappointing. Routine procedures were frequently delayed, and when assistance was requested, the behaviour was often rude towards both patients and visitors. In contrast, the ward-boy staff were more cooperative, welcoming, and helpful.

The discharge process was particularly frustrating. It began around 10:30 AM, but the paperwork was not handled in a timely manner and took over six hours to complete. There was no clear communication, and responsibility for delays was repeatedly shifted between departments. Since both of my parents and many other patients in the ward are diabetic, such prolonged delays are especially challenging. This is not an overreaction, but a genuine concern.

Additionally, the behaviour at the cashier counter was unprofessional. The staff member was rude, provided no estimate of waiting time, did not manage the queue properly, and even threatened to call security when questioned politely.

I understand that healthcare jobs demand immense patience and resilience, but this also comes with a responsibility to maintain professionalism and empathy, especially towards patients who are already vulnerable.

I am unsure whether these issues stem from hospital management or understaffing, but there is clearly room for improvement and accountability.

Despite these concerns, I remain grateful for the medical care and treatment provided by the doctors and the hospital overall.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Tawde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently donated blood at this blood bank and was informed that my blood had tested positive for hepatitis C antibodies using the ELISA Generation 4 method. Naturally, this news was extremely concerning, so I took it upon myself to get retested at a private lab. The private lab conducted two tests—one using the rapid method and the other using the ELFA method. Both of these tests came back negative for hepatitis C antibodies. To be absolutely sure, I also did an HCV RNA PCR test, which is the most reliable test for detecting an active hepatitis C infection. Thankfully, the result was "NOT DETECTED," meaning there was no active virus in my blood.

This whole experience has caused me unnecessary stress and confusion. I fully understand that antibody tests can sometimes give false positives, but I believe the blood bank should be more cautious and thorough before alarming donors with such serious results. Furthermore, after receiving the initial notification, I reached out to the blood bank multiple times seeking guidance on what to do next, but they have stopped responding to my queries. They haven’t provided any further support, leaving me in the dark about whether I can donate blood in the future or what steps I should take.

This lack of communication and support from the blood bank is extremely disappointing, especially when dealing with such sensitive health concerns. I advise others to be cautious and double-check their results if they receive any alarming notifications from this blood bank. I hope the blood bank improves their processes, both in terms of accuracy and in providing proper guidance to donors.

I visited the hospital for blood donation with a genuine intention to help others. During the screening, I was told that my hemoglobin level was low. However, after further tests, everything came out normal and there was no health issue found.

I hope the hospital management improves staff training and ensures accurate guidance is given to donors in the future.

Had visited here for voluntary blood donation. The experience was very good as the staff were courteous and professional.

featured_reviews.name: TripperHD Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is a state-of-the-art facility located in Charni Road, Mumbai, India. It is licensed by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for the collection, testing, processing, and storage of blood and blood components. The blood bank is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provides services to patients at Saifee Hospital and other hospitals in the Mumbai area.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank collects 100% voluntary blood donations. All blood donors are screened for eligibility and their blood is tested for a variety of diseases, including HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, syphilis, and malaria. The blood bank also uses the latest technology to process and store blood safely and effectively.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank provides a wide range of blood and blood components, including:

Whole blood
Packed red cells
Saline-washed red cells
Fresh frozen plasma
Random platelet concentrate
Cryoprecipitate
Leucodepleted single donor platelet by plateletpheresis
Leukocytes by leukopheresis
Single donor plasma by plasmapheresis

The blood bank also provides a number of other services, such as:

Blood compatibility testing
Transfusion counseling
Blood component therapy
Blood product storage and transportation
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is committed to providing high-quality blood and blood components to patients in need. The blood bank has a team of experienced and qualified staff who are dedicated to ensuring the safety and efficacy of the blood products they supply.

Established by the Dawoodi Bohra community, the hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and a dedicated medical staff. Saifee Hospital is known for its comprehensive range of medical specialties, cutting-edge technology, and a patient-centric approach. The hospital has earned a reputation for excellence in various medical fields, including surgery, cardiology, oncology, and obstetrics. With a focus on delivering compassionate and advanced medical care, Saifee Hospital stands as a pillar of health in the bustling city of Mumbai, catering to the diverse healthcare needs of the community it serves.

featured_reviews.name: Kishor Badiani
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a very smooth and efficient experience from start to finish. We made an appointment the day before in person for the next day and chose the full medical package and added some more cancer markers. We met pascale Fernandez at the reception who was very  helpful and technically competent to explain all the tests covered in the package. We found it best to make the appointment in person and explain our requirements and time constraints. We arrived at 8.30 am the following day and were assigned a very competent and efficient young lady by the name of Vidhi. She immediately got to wok and started with blood tests as we were fasting. She then arranged a very tasty breakfast on the
Lounge and while I was enjoying breakfast she lined up all the consultants doing the tests. All my tests were done within 5 hours by very experienced,  technically competent and amenable consultants. I will have all the reports tomorrow explained by a qualifed and experienced consultant. I highly recommend this medical centre to anyone wanting a full or partial medical check up. All
At a very reasonable price. Hence the 5 star rating.

featured_reviews.name: Pranjal Valvi
featured_reviews.review_text: The medical center is very easy to find. The staff is very good and sweet to talk. They guide you very well for the further checkups. The doctors too did the checkup very precisely. Since for me it was a full body checkup, it took time but they made sure I would get a proper breakfast to eat as well as a lounge to wait for the person accompanying you. Overall, would highly recommend this medical center for health checkups!!

featured_reviews.name: MONA GANDHI
featured_reviews.review_text: Fast but not necessarily  efficient. Dexa scan missed my right arm completely where i hve a lot of issues. Usg missed my ovaries and no effort was made to try and see them as i am at an age where it matters a lot. Gyn was not available to consult even when i had blood in urine. Overall not happy as the point of doing the testing was defeated . The usg dr did call me and offered free vaginal testing but I am upset that they did not do it in the first place. Despite  telling them the issues nothing was done. They overcharge too
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.
At first, we would like to clarify that certain ultrasound findings, including visualization of ovaries, can sometimes be technically difficult depending on factors such as bowel gas, body habitus, and preparation status. However, our radiologist did contact you personally and offered a complimentary transvaginal scan to further evaluate the ovaries, as patient care remains our priority.
Regarding the DEXA scan, the examination is performed according to standard protocols.
As for the gynecology consultation, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. Your feedback has been noted seriously and will help us improve coordination and communication for future patients.
We always strive to provide comprehensive and ethical healthcare services, and we regret that you felt dissatisfied with your experience.
Thanking you,
Team PH Medical Center

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Dangale
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited P H Medical Centre for some diagnostic tests and was really satisfied with the service. The staff was professional and helpful, the facility was clean, and everything was well-organized. The test process was quick and hassle-free, and I received my reports on time. Would definitely recommend this place for medical tests.

featured_reviews.name: Twinkle Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Did not give the xray on time. There was a delay of three days. Other centres give it within an hour. Would not recommend any dentist for sending their patients for opg or cbct!! They put the blame on having too many patients and the technician and doctors not being available.In response to the  comment below the executive could have called an asked the type of report needed, well covered for inadequacy!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Dr. Twinkle Jain,

We would like to clarify that the delay occurred because the patient was referred without adequate clinical history from the treating doctor. For diagnostic imaging such as OPG or CBCT, proper clinical details are essential to ensure the scan and interpretation are accurate and clinically meaningful.

In this case, the required information had to be obtained later, which resulted in the delay. Our centre prioritizes accuracy and patient safety over rushing investigations without proper medical context.

We respectfully request referring doctors to provide complete clinical history when sending patients for specialized imaging to avoid such delays in the future.

Regards,
P.H. Medical Centre.
